reason: I want to pick my own vegetables and meat, and I would not hand that to someone I don't know. I already get bread and labneh at the dekkene most days and do my big shop in Jbeil on Saturday, so this doesn't fill a gap for me.
objection: Someone else chooses my tomatoes and my meat, and I have to wait until the evening and collect it myself, so it isn't any easier than the dekkene.
would_change_my_mind: If I could send a photo of what I want, or they sent me a picture before buying, and I could refuse what I don't like at pickup.
